    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

            if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    freq = {v: vals.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
    background = max(freq, key=freq.get)
    out = []

                    for c in range(col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])]
            row.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in tile) == 2 else background)
